protocol.admission: C means submitted closed-cohort size. It does not assert that all requests enter one native iteration. Record actual membership in a separate trace lane.
protocol.change_reason: The exact Base2.6B TP1 C8 N4096 plus 128-output KV capacity is 49.5 GiB. A 32 GiB pool would force capacity-related admission changes. Use 52 GiB per rank uniformly. No v1 job ran.
protocol.output_policy: Native allowed_token_ids restricts each request to the first frozen non-EOS teacher token. This is not task accuracy.
protocol.request_independence: Two frozen calibration prompt shapes repeat within larger cohorts. Five repeats are not five independent request populations.
protocol.scope: A stronger generic low-concurrency ready-work baseline. Do not compare constant-token trials directly to earlier changing-teacher trials.
protocol.separate_experiment: No adaptive CDB/refill or hindsight request-placement experiment is repeated.

quality: NOT_RUN. Constant allowed-token output is a controlled hardware workload.
